items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Isidore's dad, I think. Over there in Thompson, Lake Brownshed.

ctx.x: Yeah, the bass violin. The other one called him E. Flat. The Fritz brothers, good kind of guy. We're still over there. Isidore's dad, I think. Over there in Thompson, Lake Brownshed.
Yeah, over around Covington he played.
